nativeZh: prep. 到, 向, 趋于

senses.en: The preposition to primarily indicates approach and arrival, motion made in the direction of a place or thing and attaining it, access; and also, motion or tendency without arrival; movement toward; -- opposed to from.
senses.zh: 其前言主要指向和到达,向某地或某物方向提出的动议以及达到,进入;以及没有到达的动作或倾向;向着 -- --反对来自。

senses.en: Hence, it indicates motion, course, or tendency toward a time, a state or condition, an aim, or anything capable of being regarded as a limit to a tendency, movement, or action; as, he is going to a trade; he is rising to wealth and honor.
senses.zh: 因此,它表明一种运动、过程或倾向,走向一个时代、一个状态或条件、一个目标,或任何能够被视为一种倾向、运动或行动的限制;因为他正在从事一种贸易;他正在走向财富和荣誉。

senses.en: In a very general way, and with innumerable varieties of application, to connects transitive verbs with their remoter or indirect object, and adjectives, nouns, and neuter or passive verbs with a following noun which limits their action. Its sphere verges upon that of for, but it contains less the idea of design or appropriation; as, these remarks were addressed to a large audience; let us keep this seat to ourselves; a substance sweet to the taste; an event painful to the mind; duty to God and to our parents; a dislike to spirituous liquor.
senses.zh: 以非常笼统的方式,并且有无数种应用,将过渡性动词与其偏僻或间接对象,以及形容词、名词、中子动词或被动动词连接起来,并附带一个限制其行动的名词。 其范围濒临边缘,但包含较少的设计或侵占概念;因为这些话是针对广大听众的;让我们保持这个位置;一种对味道甜美的物质;一种使心灵痛苦的事件;对上帝和我们父母的责任;一种对精神酒的厌恶。

senses.en: As sign of the infinitive, to had originally the use of last defined, governing the infinitive as a verbal noun, and connecting it as indirect object with a preceding verb or adjective; thus, ready to go, i.e., ready unto going; good to eat, i.e., good for eating; I do my utmost to lead my life pleasantly. But it has come to be the almost constant prefix to the infinitive, even in situations where it has no prepositional meaning, as where the infinitive is direct object or subject; thus, I love to learn, i.e., I love learning; to die for one's country is noble, i.e., the dying for one's country. Where the infinitive denotes the design or purpose, good usage formerly allowed the prefixing of for to the to; as, what went ye out for see? (Matt. xi. 8).
senses.zh: 作为无穷的标志,最初使用最后定义,将无穷作为口头名词,将其作为间接对象与前一个动词或形容词联系起来;因此,准备去,即准备去;好吃,即吃,即吃;我尽我最大的努力过上愉快的生活。但即使在没有前置意义的情况下,它也几乎是无穷的前缀,因为无穷是直接的对象或主题;因此,我热爱学习,即我热爱学习;为一个国家而死,即为一个国家而死是崇高的;无穷的表示设计或目的之处,过去的良好用法允许先缀到国家;你们看什么? (Matt.xi.8) 。

senses.en: In many phrases, and in connection with many other words, to has a pregnant meaning, or is used elliptically.
senses.zh: 在许多短语中,以及与其他许多词语相关联,具有怀孕的含义,或被椭圆使用.

senses.en: Extent; limit; degree of comprehension; inclusion as far as; as, they met us to the number of three hundred.
senses.zh: 程度、限度、理解程度、包容程度,因为他们与我们相遇的人数达300人。

senses.en: Effect; end; consequence; as, the prince was flattered to his ruin; he engaged in a war to his cost; violent factions exist to the prejudice of the state.
senses.zh: 效果; 结局; 后果;因为王子被宠坏;他进行一场战争,他付出了代价; 暴力派别的存在, 对国家的偏见。

senses.en: Apposition; connection; antithesis; opposition; as, they engaged hand to hand.
senses.zh: 姿势; 联系; 反论;反对;如,他们用手牵手。

senses.en: Accord; adaptation; as, an occupation to his taste; she has a husband to her mind.
senses.zh: 同意;适应;像他喜欢的职业;她有一个丈夫。

senses.en: Comparison; as, three is to nine as nine is to twenty-seven; it is ten to one that you will offend him.
senses.zh: 比较一下,三比九,九比二十七,你会冒犯他
添加; 结合; 积累.

senses.en: Accompaniment; as, she sang to his guitar; they danced to the music of a piano.
senses.zh: 伴奏;如她唱他的吉他;他们舞动钢琴的音乐.

senses.en: Character; condition of being; purpose subserved or office filled.
senses.zh: 字符; 存在条件; 目的获得服务或办公室得到填补。
